actual_call.prompt: Use case: ads-marketing. One square clean TWO-CARD product-controls detail photograph composition, no text. Image1 actual silver front, image2 actual closeup, image3 actual side, image4 actual pressed-button closeup is only construction evidence and MUST NOT contribute hand/press-action/red protruding pins. Image5 is STYLE ONLY: borrow its two side-by-side equal cards and blue-white restrained hierarchy, NOT its skin, droplets, VS, claims or objects. ACTUAL PRODUCT DETAILS: realistic bright mirror SILVER shell/rim, black finely textured face, dense small off-white separate nozzle rings each with a dark center, original dark microhole outer border. Central RED control is the actual low wide circular flange plus smaller concentric raised boss with dark center opening; do not enlarge relative to neighboring holes, do not replace with a huge doughnut or add a new black pedestal. The separate lower button is the actual shiny SILVER rounded-rectangle in black insert, not black and not a red control. Exact source-photo visual character, not CG clay. No text, letters, logos, arrows, diagrams, performance comparisons, dimensions, filter parts, certificates, human/hand/finger, water or spray. Dry resting product; no press-action, no long red needles, no exploding internals. Real product photographs override all other references. LAYOUT: pure white / very pale cool gray square canvas. Leave upper18% totally empty for a future title. From x6–48% and x52–94%, y28–75%, show two equal clean rectangular photo windows separated by a narrow white gutter, flat and borderless. LEFT window: a tight photographic crop of the true CENTRAL RED control surrounded by several rows of actual white ring nozzles on black face. Red button at window center, photographed near-front, about20% of window width, not a giant new part. RIGHT window: a separate tight crop of the actual LOWER SILVER selector, black insert and a little surrounding mirror silver neck; selector centered, recognizable rounded rectangle, actual curvature and polished highlight. These are two magnified areas of the SAME actual silver product, no invented additional button. Focus and light match; glossy silver only in right window, real fine dark face texture in left. Both controls resting, no visible hand. Leave y78–95% beneath both windows blank white for independently added Chinese captions. No rendered text or placeholder boxes. Do not show the whole showerhead twice; two distinct detail windows only.
